title: Add multi-page sweet messages flow and a virtual box of chocolates gifting view

requirements.text: Convert the current single-page Chocolate Day experience into a simple multi-page (multi-step) flow within the frontend, with clear Next/Back navigation and a visible progress indicator, while keeping the existing Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut reveal interaction available in the flow.

quotes: Add more message in the next few pages ...

acceptanceCriteria: The experience contains multiple steps/pages (at least 3 total) presented as a guided flow.
Users can move forward/backward using clearly labeled buttons (e.g., “Next”, “Back”).
A progress indicator (e.g., Step 1 of N / dots) is visible and updates correctly.
The existing Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut card and message reveal modal still work and are reachable from within the flow.
Navigation and dialogs are keyboard accessible (Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter/Space), with visible focus states.

requirements.text: Add additional romantic/sweet message content across the subsequent pages that praises the recipient (e.g., how sweet he is), using English user-facing text and keeping the tone romantic and heartfelt.

quotes: Add more message in the next few pages like how sweet he his and all

acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 additional pages/steps contain new romantic message content beyond the existing chocolate reveal message.
All added user-facing copy is in English and reads naturally.
The new pages visually match the existing romantic theme (rose/pink/amber palette) and remain readable in light/dark modes.
No copy implies multiple favorite chocolates; the favorite remains singular (Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut).

requirements.text: Add a “virtual chocolates” gifting experience as a dedicated page/step featuring a visually rich ‘box full of chocolates’ view (open box with assorted chocolates), including a small romantic note for him.

quotes: Also bring some virtual chocolates for him create one like the box full of chocolates

acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated step/page exists that prominently shows a ‘box full of chocolates’ visual.
The box view includes a lightweight interaction (e.g., an “Open the box” / “Reveal chocolates” button or tap target) that reveals the chocolates and a short romantic note.
The interaction is accessible: can be triggered via keyboard; respects reduced-motion preferences where applicable (no mandatory heavy animation).
The gifting experience is decorative/virtual and does not introduce additional selectable chocolate options that conflict with the single-favorite-chocolate gallery.

requirements.text: Integrate the required new static image assets for the virtual chocolate box experience under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the new gifting step/page (no backend image serving).

quotes: create one like the box full of chocolates

acceptanceCriteria: New images are added under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced via /assets/generated/... paths.
The gifting step/page renders correctly with the new assets in both light and dark mode.
No backend code is added for image serving.

constraints: Keep the interactive chocolate selection limited to only “Dairy Milk Fruit & Nut”; do not add additional selectable chocolate options to the gallery.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Do not add additional backend services or external databases; keep changes in the existing React frontend unless a backend change is explicitly required (it is not for this request).
nonGoals: Implementing payments, checkout, or real-world chocolate purchasing/shipping.
Adding third-party authentication providers (Internet Identity remains as-is).
Adding multiple chocolate choices to the interactive gallery (the ‘box full of chocolates’ is a virtual/visual gift element, not a multi-item selector).

required: Illustration of an elegant closed gift box for chocolates, romantic color palette (chocolate-gift-box-closed.dim_1200x800.png)
Illustration/top-view of an open gift box filled with assorted chocolates (chocolate-gift-box-open.dim_1200x800.png)
Seamless pattern background of small hearts and cocoa elements, warm tones (chocolate-pattern-bg.dim_1600x900.png)
